_comment: rec-4381 live proof: captured from PLAN-platform-iam-personal-release (PR #1540), the first terraform/personal PR whose speculative plan ran after PLAN-ducklake-zip-inputs-moved (#1536) merged. inputs_record is a real excerpt of the schema-1 record uploaded to lambda-packages/<PR head sha>/inputs.json -- schema and per-artifact md5 only (the fields VP step 7 itself reads); the record also carries per-file entries/inputs blob-hash maps, omitted here since they are not asserted on and would otherwise flood the secrets scanner with hash-shaped false positives. recomputed_zip_md5s is independently hashed from the same-named zips re-fetched from S3 at capture time, never copied from inputs_record. convergence_record_at_merge mirrors the real convergence/personal/sandbox.json shape (scripts/ci/ducklake_artifacts.py) at the gated-apply write for this merge; plan_sha is independently recomputed (sha256) from the same saved plan.bin, which also matches the digest the terraform-apply-sandbox workflow posted on the PR.
